# Trad Directory

> A curated, worldwide directory of traditional (American "old-school") tattoo
> artists and the shops they work at. Browse by artist, shop, city, or country,
> or explore an interactive map. ~1,460 artists across ~320 shops in 40+
> countries.

Each artist and shop has its own page with location, Instagram, and (for shops)
their resident artists. Pages are server-rendered with Schema.org structured
data (Person for artists, TattooParlor for shops).

## Key pages

- [All artists](https://www.trad-directory.com/artists): browse every traditional tattoo artist
- [All shops](https://www.trad-directory.com/shops): browse traditional tattoo shops
- [Countries](https://www.trad-directory.com/countries): artists and shops grouped by country
- [Map](https://www.trad-directory.com/map): interactive map of artists and shops
- [About](https://www.trad-directory.com/about): what Trad Directory is

## Complete index

- [sitemap.xml](https://www.trad-directory.com/sitemap.xml): every artist and shop page

## Notes

- Artist page URL: `https://www.trad-directory.com/artist/{slug}`
- Shop page URL: `https://www.trad-directory.com/shop/{slug}`
- Contact / suggest a listing: via the "Suggest an Artist" action on the site.
